description.value: A compact 7-site park in riverside cottonwoods just north of Oliver, positioned as a tenter-friendly base for cycling the International Hike and Bike Trail or riding to South Okanagan wineries. The park itself offers little beyond bird watching and a short dike walk; abundant poison ivy keeps you on the paths.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The BC Parks website confirms Inkaneep Park is an active frontcountry campground with 7 sites along the Okanagan River, well-positioned for cycling tourism via the International Hike and Bike Trail and backroads to South Okanagan wineries. The website's cycling section explicitly states e-bikes are not permitted on trails (road use only), which is useful for cyclists to know. Most amenity fields (showers, water, tools, etc.) are not addressed in the fetched content, so they remain null; the OSM phone appears to be the operator's direct line but could not be confirmed from the partially retrieved contact section of the park page.
concerns: OSM phone (+1-250-584-9025) appears to be the park operator (Quality Recreation Ltd.) direct line; the Inkaneep-specific 'Contact' section was not fully captured in the fetched content, so this number could not be confirmed or denied.

E-bikes are explicitly prohibited on park trails per website cycling section ('bicycles with electric assist motors (e-bikes) are not allowed on the trails within Inkaneep Park'); relevant caution for e-bike tourers.
Very small campground (7 sites per OSM capacity tag); consistent with website note that it 'often has sites available, even during peak periods.'
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active BC Parks campground with strong touring-cyclist appeal — directly adjacent to the International Hike and Bike Trail and backroads to South Okanagan wineries; well-suited to tenters and small setups typical of cycle touring.
